# The White House

> > Official website of the United States White House, documenting President Donald J. Trump's executive actions, policy initiatives, and administration priorities.

This site serves as the primary source for presidential actions including executive orders, proclamations, fact sheets, and policy announcements. It covers key administration priorities including border security, economic policy, defense modernization, foreign policy, and domestic reforms.

## Key Topics

- Executive Orders
- Border Security & Immigration Enforcement
- Defense Acquisitions & Industrial Base
- Foreign Investment & Economic Policy
- Tariffs & Trade
- Human Rights & Foreign Policy
- Healthcare Price Transparency
- Energy Policy & Clean Coal
- Military Capabilities & National Security
- Procurement Modernization
- Gender Ideology & Biological Truth
- Hostage Release & Wrongful Detainee
- South Africa Sanctions
- Legal System Reform
- Religious Liberty

## Executive Orders & Presidential Actions

- [Clarifying The Military's Role In Protecting The Territorial Integrity Of The United States](https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/2025/01/clarifying-the-militarys-role-in-protecting-the-territorial-integrity-of-the-united-states): Executive order deploying military via USNORTHCOM for border security
- [Defending Women From Gender Ideology Extremism And Restoring Biological Truth To The Federal Government](https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/2025/01/defending-women-from-gender-ideology-extremism-and-restoring-biological-truth-to-the-federal-government): Executive order establishing biological sex policy across federal government
- [Modernizing Defense Acquisitions and Spurring Innovation in the Defense Industrial Base](https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/2025/04/modernizing-defense-acquisitions-and-spurring-innovation-in-the-defense-industrial-base): Executive order modernizing DoD acquisitions via Adaptive Acquisition Framework
- [Reinvigorating America's Beautiful Clean Coal Industry and Amending Executive Order 14241](https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/2025/04/reinvigorating-americas-beautiful-clean-coal-industry-and-amending-executive-order-14241): Executive order promoting clean coal industry and amending energy policy
- [Establishment of The White House Faith Office](https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/2025/02/establishment-of-the-white-house-faith-office): Executive order establishing White House Faith Office for religious liberty
- [Addressing Risks from Paul Weiss](https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/2025/03/addressing-risks-from-paul-weiss): Executive order restricting Paul Weiss law firm from federal contracts
- [ADDRESSING REMEDIAL ACTION BY PAUL WEISS](https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/2025/03/addressing-remedial-action-by-paul-weiss): Executive order on Paul Weiss law firm remedial action and policy revocation
- [Review of Proposed United States Steel Corporation Acquisition](https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/2025/04/review-of-proposed-united-states-steel-corporation-acquisition): Presidential memo reviewing Nippon Steel's proposed U.S. Steel acquisition

## Administration Highlights & Policy Announcements

- [The First 100 Hours: Historic Action to Kick off America's Golden Age](https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/2025/01/the-first-100-hours-historic-action-to-kick-off-americas-golden-age): Trump's first 100 hours: executive orders, border security, AI investments
- [JOBS, JOBS, JOBS: Explosive Job Growth in March as Trump Economy Booms](https://www.whitehouse.gov/articles/2025/04/jobs-jobs-jobs-explosive-job-growth-in-march-as-trump-economy-booms): March jobs report shows explosive private sector growth under Trump
- [More Investment, More Jobs, and More Money in Americans' Pockets](https://www.whitehouse.gov/articles/2025/03/more-investment-more-jobs-and-more-money-in-americans-pockets): Hyundai's $20B US investment including $5.8B Louisiana steel plant announced

## Foreign Policy & National Security

- [Fact Sheet: President Donald J. Trump Re-designates the Houthis as a Foreign Terrorist Organization](https://www.whitehouse.gov/fact-sheets/2025/01/fact-sheet-president-donald-j-trump-re-designates-the-houthis-as-a-foreign-terrorist-organization): Trump re-designates Houthis as Foreign Terrorist Organization for Red Sea attacks
- [Fact Sheet: President Donald J. Trump Addresses Human Rights Violations in South Africa](https://www.whitehouse.gov/fact-sheets/2025/02/fact-sheet-president-donald-j-trump-addresses-human-rights-violations-in-south-africa): Trump executive order addressing South Africa human rights violations
- [Readout of President Donald J. Trump's Meeting with King Abdullah II of Jordan](https://www.whitehouse.gov/briefings-statements/2025/02/readout-of-president-donald-j-trumps-meeting-with-king-abdullah-ii-of-jordan): Trump meets King Abdullah II on Gaza conflict and regional security issues

## Domestic Policy & Reform Initiatives

- [Fact Sheet: President Donald J. Trump Announces Actions to Make Healthcare Prices Transparent](https://www.whitehouse.gov/fact-sheets/2025/02/fact-sheet-president-donald-j-trump-announces-actions-to-make-healthcare-prices-transparent): Trump executive order mandating healthcare and prescription drug price transparency
- [Fact Sheet: President Donald J. Trump Prevents Abuses of the Legal System and the Federal Courts](https://www.whitehouse.gov/fact-sheets/2025/03/fact-sheet-president-donald-j-trump-prevents-abuses-of-the-legal-system-and-the-federal-courts): Trump memo addressing attorney misconduct and frivolous litigation sanctions
- [Fact Sheet: President Donald J. Trump Works to Make Our Nation's Capital Safe and Beautiful](https://www.whitehouse.gov/fact-sheets/2025/03/fact-sheet-president-donald-j-trump-works-to-make-our-nations-capital-safe-and-beautiful): Trump executive order creating DC Safe and Beautiful Task Force
- [Fact Sheet: President Donald J. Trump Unleashes American Commercial Fishing in the Pacific](https://www.whitehouse.gov/fact-sheets/2025/04/fact-sheet-president-donald-j-trump-unleashes-american-commercial-fishing-in-the-pacific): Trump proclamation opens Pacific Remote Islands Marine Monument to fishing

## Economic Policy & Trade

- [Fact Sheet: President Donald J. Trump Issues Directive to Prevent the Unfair Exploitation of American Innovation](https://www.whitehouse.gov/fact-sheets/2025/02/fact-sheet-president-donald-j-trump-issues-directive-to-prevent-the-unfair-exploitation-of-american-innovation): Trump memo protecting US companies from unfair digital service taxes abroad

## Optional

- [U.S. Hostage and Wrongful Detainee Day, 2025](https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/2025/03/u-s-hostage-and-wrongful-detainee-day-2025): Presidential proclamation for March 9 US Hostage and Wrongful Detainee Day
